## VERDICT
The dominant B=1 tree speed tax is NOT the graph/row/scheduler surface the census pointed at. It is the caterpillar drafter computing the full-vocab bf16 lm-head logits TWICE per drafter step: +5.45 cuBLAS `internal::gemvx` calls/draft × 15.05 ms = **+81.9 ms/draft = ~87-93% of the measured per-forward gap** (profiled gap +92.2 ms GPU-busy/draft; s/fwd 0.312 vs 0.218 this paired capture = 1.43x).

## ROOT CAUSE (read in source, not guessed)
`scripts/fr10_phase4_patch_vllm_tree_gdn.py` (FR10_CATERPILLAR_NATIVE_SPINE_TOP2 drafter):
- Root step ~L7288: `_fr10_logits = self.model.compute_logits(sample_hidden_states)` ... then `draft_token_ids = self._greedy_sample(sample_hidden_states)`
- Loop steps ~L7401: `_fr10_step_logits = self.model.compute_logits(last_hidden_states[:batch_size])` ... then `draft_token_ids = self._greedy_sample(last_hidden_states[:batch_size])`
- vLLM `eagle.py:398-402` (pinned image): `_greedy_sample = self.model.compute_logits(hidden_states).argmax(dim=-1)` → every drafter step pays the 1.556 GB bf16 lm-head read twice (15.05 ms each, 103 GB/s effective = 38% of the 273 GB/s GB10 peak). The code comment says "read the runner-up token from the same logits" — the intent was reuse; the implementation recomputes. 5 doublings/event ≈ +75 ms, matching measured +81.9 incl. amortized extras. For SPINE-ONLY trees (chain5) `_fr10_step_logits`/top-2 is computed and NEVER USED — pure waste; cat9 uses it but redundantly.
- SEMANTICS-PRESERVING FIX CANDIDATE (not applied; subject to the binding lossless gate): `draft_token_ids = _fr10_step_logits.argmax(dim=-1)` (argmax of the SAME tensor → byte-identical tokens), skip the extra compute_logits entirely in spine-only mode. Caveat: if `use_local_argmax_reduction` is true, `_greedy_sample` routes through `get_top_tokens` — fix must be flag-aware and byte-checked. Expected: chain ~0.31 → ~0.23-0.24 s/fwd (≈1.05-1.10x native).

## CAPTURE-METHOD FIX (the reason prior kernel tables were empty)
Two node-trace attempts dropped ALL kernel rows ("incomplete CUPTI events dropped: 102,320 / 89,042 ... GPU timestamp information have not been retrieved") even with `--cuda-flush-interval 100` and with `CuptiUseRawGpuTimestamps=false` written to the in-container nsys config — that option string does not exist in 2026.2.1 binaries (removed), and flushing more often is orthogonal. Root cause: on GB10+CUDA13, `--trace=cuda` uses the HARDWARE trace engine for kernel records; its GPU-timestamp retrieval fails at delayed-session stop (memcpy/memset/runtime software records always survived). FIX: `--trace=cuda,cuda-sw,nvtx` (software CUPTI kernel records) → 364,628 chain rows (80.3% in-graph) / 121,656 native rows, ZERO drops. Wired as `LUMO_NSYS_TRACE` (default `cuda,nvtx` unchanged) + `LUMO_NSYS_CONFIG_DIRECTIVES` passthrough in both launchers; `tests/test_fr13_nsys_launcher_wiring.py` extended, 2 passed.
